records.description: A Model of Brand. The diagram attempts to present a comprehensive model of brand and to unpack the meaning of the term by providing related concepts and examples. The map is framed around four main ideas: (i) a brand is more than a name or symbol, (ii) creating a great customer experience is the essence of good branding, (iii) perceptions of a brand can be measured, and (iv) brands are a form of sign.    http://www.dubberly.com/wp-content/uploads/2008/06/ddo_brand.pdf

records.description: Nuit Debout is a social movement that started in France on 31st March 2016 following the mobilization against labor market reform. People have been gathering at Paris' Place de la République every night to discuss political and social issues the same way it happened in New York (#Occupy) and Spain (Los Indignados). In recent weeks several Magnum photographers have visited the Place de la République to document developments.  This image was taken by Lorenzo Meloni on April 20 2016.  #LorenzoMeloni/#MagnumPhotos  #NuitDebout by magnumphotos
